info.name: StayFinder API
info.description:
Test calls for the StayFinder API: every rule has a call that should succeed and calls that should be rejected.
Each request checks its expected status code (and sometimes a value in the body), so the Collection Runner shows a pass or fail per call.

Before running: seed the database (3 steps in backend/README.md) and start the backend (`npm run dev` in backend/).
Run the whole collection top to bottom: Postman keeps the session cookie between requests, like a browser.
Terminal: `npx newman run tests/stayfinder.postman_collection.json` in backend/.

exec: // Runs before every request. Sets {{d60}} = today + 60 days as YYYY-MM-DD, {{dMinus1}} = yesterday, and so on.
// Postman has no built-in "today + N days" variable, and booking dates must stay in the future.

Bookings
item.description:
Bookings (G9, G10, G12, G14, VG1, VG2, VG3, VG5, VG6)
Dates are relative to today ({{d60}} = today + 60 days, set by the collection pre-request script),
and every booking created here is deleted at the end, so the file can be run again.
The overlap tests use bookings made in this file, not the seeded ones (their dates move with the seed day).
